page.overview:
Who is 009?

Rhys Beckett, also known as 009, was a former intelligence operative of the Double-O Section.

The character appeared in the IO Interactive James Bond video game 007 First Light. He is a former 00 agent who was falsely accused of treason by THEIA, hunted by John Greenway and forced to go into hiding under Bawma's protection. However, he later discovered the truth of the supposed treason and attempted to contact MI6 about it.

However, this attempt was used as a bait by Sir Nicholas Webb and Damien Webb to assassinate the MI6 Personnels, but the plan was foiled by James Bond and despite successfully wounding John and three other MI6 Recruits including Cressida and killing three other recruits including Monroe, not only failed to kill 009 but also drew Bond and Greenway to the case.

The duo tracked 009 to Aleph, Mauritania where they managed to board the yacht he was hiding on only to find him already shot, tortured and left to bled out. However, he managed to leave behind a clue on a photo of him and Greenway which led them to a ship containing a safehouse of his where he left a briefcase containing files regarding the Webbs' dealings. Unfortunately, the ship are attacked by Webb's mercenaries, who thwarted Bond and Greenway's escape. One mercenary picked up the briefcase containing the evidence and accidentally triggered its self-destruct, killing him and incinerating the evidence. After Bond and Greenway survive thanks to the intervention of Bawma and reported back to London, without the evidence, M was forced to close the case and declare 009 the culprit.
